assets.name: portrait-1-v2.png
assets.prompt: Create a fresh full-body fighting game portrait of the SPECIFIC adult man in photos 1-4, Jopa. Likeness is the highest priority: closely reproduce his actual face, not a generic handsome hero. Photo1 gym selfie is primary frontal identity; photo2 wedding is sharp facial structure/hair reference; photo3 pool selfie man on right provides nose/lips/jaw; photo4 peach-shirt smile corroborates identity. Oval slightly long face, soft tapered jaw and rounded chin, full natural lips with prominent lower lip, relaxed almond-shaped dark eyes with heavy upper eyelids, straight dark eyebrows, natural broad rounded nose tip. Short dark hair lies relatively flat and side-swept with small curved fringe on forehead, short sides; NOT tall curled quiff. Very faint chin stubble only, no beard. Natural light-medium warm skin, no exaggerated cheekbones or square jaw. Mild closed-mouth confident expression so facial structure remains accurate. Slim normal athletic body, narrow natural neck, 1.76m, not bulky. Full body in relaxed fighting guard, both fists raised, turned slightly right with face mostly toward viewer, shoes entirely visible. White crewneck short-sleeve T-shirt with tiny dark chest tag and beige above-knee shorts, white low-top sneakers. Art style is polished realistically painted game portrait like reference5 Bozo, orange and blue rim light, clean high-quality surfaces. Reference5 is STYLE ONLY, not identity or proportions; no beard/glasses/powers copied. Genuinely transparent background. No scenery, text, props, no repetitive geometric skin texture. New image based on real photos, not previous rejected illustration.
